description: Fetch trending-keyword rankings from Pinterest Trends (https://trends.pinterest.com/), Pinterest's official trends tool. Three ranking types: featured (top trending search terms with month-over-month growth, filterable by region and interest category, default), shopping (trending product categories by outbound-click growth), and search (keyword table with weekly/monthly/yearly change; use --sort to pick the growth / seasonal / monthly-best / yearly-best tab). Requires a logged-in browser session.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Which ranking to return: featured (top trends by Pin-save growth, default) | shopping (trending shopping product categories) | search (search-keyword trend table).

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Region code (default us). Countries: us, uk, ca, de, fr, it, es, br, mx, ar, co, au, my, ph, th, eg, tr, kr. Regional groups: south-europe, germanic, nordic, benelux, eastern-europe, hispanic-latam, latam-caribbean, east-europe-med.

parameters.name: interest
parameters.description: Interest category filter, only used when type=featured: all (default) or one of animals, weddings, home-decor, architecture, health, education, travel, beauty, fashion, food-drink, event-planning, art, parenting, gardening, diy-crafts.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Search-trends tab, only used when type=search: growth (fastest-growing, default) | seasonal | monthly (best of the month) | yearly (best of the year).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of entries to return (1-100, default 20). Note: featured is capped at 5 and shopping at 20 by the site.
